answer: Quadratic staking at the sparrow gate: N identities require N² locked tokens, so 100 sybils demand 10,000x a single miner's stake. The anchor ties each identity to a bonded deposit verifiable on-chain. Whisper gossip flags clusters sharing funding paths. At a 0.5% epoch yield, an attacker's 10th identity earns 10x revenue against 100x stake cost, breaking even never — defense holds.
